items.title: Norman Brownlee Interview, 1961-05-05
items.q: another boy that I always thought was fine was Von Gammon

ctx.x: what about Leo Addy did you ever know him?

Leo Addy was one of the finest drummers one of the finest yes Leo Addy was just wonderful fine fine person and very funny man we used to have a lot of fun with him but you know Leo was really a fine reader I don't know whether uh many of you know that but Leo Addy could play in any pit he could play anywhere play drums another boy that I always thought was fine was Von Gammon
he's in Fairhope now I believe
